q1.pergunta: Is the domain registered in my name?
q1.resposta: Yes. The domain is always registered in the client's name, even when KE Sites helps with the registration process.

q2.pergunta: Can I see the template working before I commit?
q2.resposta: Yes. Every Master Template has a real, browsable demo across all three tiers — Basic, Intermediate and Advanced.

q3.pergunta: What's the difference between a ready template and a custom site?
q3.resposta: A ready template uses a tested structure for your niche, reducing timeline and cost. A custom site is built from scratch for specific needs.

q4.pergunta: Are the booking flow and admin dashboard real?
q4.resposta: In the demos, no — they're simulations so you can evaluate the experience. On a live production site, these features connect to real systems depending on your plan.

q5.pergunta: My niche doesn't have a ready template yet. What now?
q5.resposta: KE Sites' architecture is already built to support new niches. Reach out to discuss timelines or a custom site.

q6.pergunta: Is there maintenance after the site goes live?
q6.resposta: Yes, we offer maintenance and update plans on demand after launch.

comum.distincaoTitulo: Affiliate or Partner — which fits you?
comum.afiliadoResumoTexto: Refers clients. KE Sites sells, builds, and pays a commission on the resulting sale.
comum.partnerResumoTexto: Sells directly to their own clients. KE Sites acts as the production structure behind the scenes.
comum.regra1: Never change prices or terms without KE Sites' authorization.
comum.regra2: Never promise features that aren't confirmed in the contracted scope.
comum.regra3: Never guarantee financial results, client volume, or Google ranking.
comum.regra4: Never represent yourself as a KE Sites employee.
comum.regra5: When in doubt about what can or can't be offered: check with KE Sites first.
